# ILOP — Intent Logistics Orders Protocol

> Open standard (draft v0.2, 2026-11-17), on top of MCP, for AI agents placing real-world orders (mail, courier, filing) for a person: quote, prepare, approve, carry out, track, prove.

Key rules for agents:
- Discover a provider at https://<domain>/.well-known/ilop.json. Trust it only from the provider's own origin.
- Every tool result carries structuredContent.ilop with ilop_state, charged, executed, payment_status, fulfillment_status.
- Never say "sent" before ACCEPTED or "mailed/shipped" before EXECUTED. COMPLETED does not mean a signature exists.
- charged or executed may be null. On error.code OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN, call status; never retry a paying operation.
- user_approved: true is never consent. The person approves on approval_url unless the host issued a payment credential.
- On MCP 2026-07-28 keep the status_handle that prepare returns; an order id alone does not unlock status.
